author: Noneofyour
quote: Trash!! It’s full of bugs and glitches and I do not want to pay £90 to paint walls, fix sinks, put together tables, fix rails, stairs etc… pick up flowers and necklaces for my “gf” who keeps texting and calling me and insulting me while Jason does everything. I am a woman playing this game and this feels like a boyfriend simulator!! Then I am doing groceries and picking up clothes for Lucia… wth!!!??? I drew the line at having to shoot bottles as a main mission and had to look 20+ minutes to look for a guy on a boat that ditches his pregnant gf to go party with women and snort coke. I got so bored I deleted it! Honestly this game feels like a weird dream!
